function getSatellitePointer(bytes32 pointerType)
        external
        view
        override
        returns (
            address target,
            bytes32 codeHash,
            bool frozen,
            bytes32 moduleType,
            bytes4 interfaceId,
            address registry,
            uint8 registryStatus,
            bytes32 moduleManifestHash,
            bytes32 deploymentManifestHash,
            uint64 revision
        )
    {
        StreamCorePointerState storage pointer = _satellitePointers[pointerType];
        return (
            pointer.target,
            pointer.codeHash,
            pointer.frozen,
            pointer.moduleType,
            pointer.interfaceId,
            pointer.registry,
            pointer.registryStatus,
            pointer.moduleManifestHash,
            pointer.deploymentManifestHash,
            pointer.revision
        );
    }
